svg.title: Brumaire 25 — Faisan
svg.desc: A calm male common pheasant stands in left-facing profile. A small green-blue head has a short horn-coloured bill and a restrained red bare cheek patch. The slender neck wears a broken cream collar above copper and ochre scalloped breast feathers. A patterned folded wing rests against the compact body; exceptionally long, narrow, barred tail feathers taper diagonally behind it. Two fine scaled legs end in separate clawed toes.
